# Engineering Decision: [Title]

> Copy this file for each new decision. Never delete or rewrite a Chosen
> decision — if it changes, mark it `Replaced` and write a new document.

## Status

Proposed / Chosen / Replaced / Rejected

(If Replaced: link to the new decision document.)

## Date

YYYY-MM-DD

## Problem

What problem were we trying to solve? Why did this decision come up now?

## What This Part of the System Does

- What goes in:
- What happens inside:
- What comes out:
- Where the output goes next:

## Requirements

What does this solution actually need to achieve? Keep it concrete.

## Options We Considered

- Option A: ...
- Option B: ...
- Option C: ...

## Comparison

Compare on the criteria that matter for this problem (quality, cost, latency,
complexity, scalability, maintainability, metadata preservation).
Use a table only if it genuinely helps understanding.

## Decision

What did we choose? One or two sentences.

## Why We Chose It

The actual reasoning — including the constraints that mattered
(time, cost, corpus, current phase).

## Trade-offs

What we're giving up. Be honest.

## What We Did Not Choose

Why not — right now, not necessarily forever.

## Assumptions

What has to stay true for this decision to hold.

## How We Will Validate This

What measurement, test, or evidence tells us this was a good call?

## When We Should Revisit It

What evidence or situation would make us reconsider?
